question: What yogic action at the root of tongue and palate enables the drinking of air?
premises: A placement is made at the root of tongue and palate
Air is the object to be drawn in
The action must be done slowly
inference: By making the proper placement at the root of tongue and palate, one should slowly drink the air.
plain_english: Having made the placement at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink the air.
